description: This file defines the Dependencies class with a ConfigureServices method to configure database contexts (both in-memory and SQL Server) based on configuration settings for dependency injection in the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: Dependencies
classes.description: Contains configuration extension method ConfigureServices for setting up database contexts based on application configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures Entity Framework database contexts (InMemory or SQL Server) based on the provided configuration and registers them with dependency injection.
